about: Amendments that carry out [USER]'s two decisions of 2026-11-01: docs/decisions/2026-11-01-polyatomic-ion-two-words.md (the file's record) and docs/decisions/2026-11-01-antibonding-orbital-andtengisvigrum.md (named by its own entry). Applied on top of amendments-2026-10-29.json and amendments-2026-10-30.json (give all three to tools/ai-review/compile-ruling-set.js, oldest first). One retarget: polyatomic ion becomes the two-word fjölatóma jón, the form Íðorðabankinn's chemistry concept already lists and the machine translation already writes; the withdrawn one-word target survives as a competitor. One add: antibonding orbital → andtengisvigrúm, the plain form of the σ*-/π*-andtengisvigrúm rulings, matching the house-style entry of the same day. Hand-written input: its sha256 is recorded in the compiled artifact, so any edit must be followed by a recompile.
